rule_title: TTP 1087.002 - Kerberos TGS Host Enumeration Burst (BloodHound)
description: Detects BloodHound/SharpHound enumerating domain hosts by requesting Kerberos service tickets for multiple computer accounts in rapid succession. All ServiceNames end with $ (computer accounts), all from the same source IP and LogonGuid within a short window. This is distinct from Kerberoasting which targets user SPNs — this targets host accounts to map reachable machines.
